name: Anthropic Provider
description: This enables the use of Anthropic for the AI module.
consumes_plugin_types: ai:OperationType (implements the chat operation-type interface from AI Core)
project_description:
Looking for some of the best models in AI? Anthropic brings you the Claude series, renowned for safe and highly effective large language models. Integrated with the AI module , Anthropic provides high-performance AI for text generation, conversation, and more, offering advanced capabilities and ethical AI practices.

 Features 
 Leverage Claude models from Anthropic with the full range of the AI module family. Use these models to enhance text processing, content generation, and intelligent conversation flows.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Configure an API key using the Key module with your Anthropic API credentials. 
 Go to /admin/config/ai/providers/anthropic and connect the API key. 
 You’re ready to start using the Claude models in your AI applications. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 The AI module .

 Supporting this Module 
 Support the AI module on OpenCollective .

 Community Documentation 
 The documentation is available on https://project.pages.drupalcode.org/ai/
